% A document whose ToUnicode maps letters to control characters, as a
% crafted PDF could: A to A and ESC, B to the C1 CSI (U+009B) and B, C to BEL
% and C. Its text must not carry them (crates/temzdf-pdfcore/src/selection.rs).
% pdfTeX maps glyphs by name, so the font needs an encoding with names (T1
% Latin Modern), and it leaves out a map to one control character alone.
% Rebuild with scripts/build-fixtures.sh.
\pdfgentounicode=1
\pdfglyphtounicode{A}{0041 001B}
\pdfglyphtounicode{B}{009B 0042}
\pdfglyphtounicode{C}{0007 0043}
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\begin{document}
xAxBxCx
\end{document}
